reviews.text: Pool Care Specialists have been our pool repair team for 15 years.  I called Doug late on Thursday with a pump leak issue, and he had it repaired by Friday AM.  Two years ago, they also modernized our controller with Wi-Fi access.  They also got us through the Snowpocalypse.
reviews.author: Bob Dietrich

reviews.text: We made an appointment to learn how to use the salt water system in a house we purchased in Colleyville and to get an estimate on a new spa heater. They were a no show and never returned our phone call after we called about the no show.
reviews.author: Lauren Brozman Olson

reviews.text: I needed a quick assessment and fix, and Doug was ready and able to meet the challenge at a great price. Every other pool service company in this area has been deleted from my contacts. Pool Care Specialists are superior to all! Thank you!!
reviews.author: Doug Page

reviews.text: Doug was very responsive for fixing a leak in my pool pump. He gave a quote using photos, came on time and fixed it. He gave some good advice on pool repair for spring. Photo is before repair.
reviews.author: Ramnath Cidambi

reviews.text: We had a pool filter that was on its last legs. We called Doug and he responded promptly, visited the same day, and gave us his recommendations. Doug came out  quickly to install our new filter, which was leaking, and we are now set. I would highly recommend this company for your pool care needs. We will definitely use them again in the future.
reviews.author: Shirley C

reviews.text: Doug is always great. Has helped with numerous repairs over the past couple years. New heater installed being the most recent.
reviews.author: Nick Lewis

reviews.text: I feel very fortunate to have found Pool Care Specialists and I highly recommend them! Shane is my weekly technician. He does an excellent job and explains everything to me, which I appreciate. I also had some needed repairs done by Doug and I have received the best service and care. I rate them 5+++!
reviews.author: Annette Wolfe

reviews.text: Could not be happier with the work done by Pool Care Specialists!! They were extremely responsive, answered all our questions (we had a lot!), and worked quickly and efficiently. They replaced all our equipment (pump, filter, and booster pump) and it looks and runs great. I would definitely recommend them!
reviews.author: Molly Dobbins

data.summary: Reviews appear overwhelmingly authentic. The high volume of detailed, specific positive reviews on Google suggests a quality contractor with a strong local reputation. The primary negative pattern is a recent no-show and lack of follow-up, which is a specific service failure but not indicative of systemic fraud. The Yelp rating discrepancy is notable but common and explained by platform differences and small sample size.
authentic_signals: Specific details (names like Doug, Shane, project types like pump leaks, Wi-Fi controllers)
Mix of long-term loyalty (15 years) and recent negative experiences
Emotionally authentic language in both positive and negative reviews
Negative review contains specific details (Colleyville, salt water system, spa heater estimate)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Google rating (4.7) is significantly higher than Yelp (3.7). This is a common pattern where Google reviews are more positive. The Yelp sample size (19) is also much smaller than Google (189), which can lead to greater rating volatility.
